text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As the end of the year approaches, Tokai Teio and I pay a visit to the Nakayama Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Oooh… I can barely move in this ocean of people!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: But this is exactly what the Arima Kinen should be like! The grand prix with all the popular runners!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Plus, I'm sure all this fuss is because of Prez! She always draws a crowd!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna be on that track next year too! They'll be calling me Tokai Teio, Champion of the Classics!
choice_data_list: We'd better do our best to make that happen.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hehe, of course!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh? Is that…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Air Groove! I knew it was you!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Ah, Teio and her esteemed trainer.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: You're here to watch too, huh? Who're you rooting for? Prez? It's gotta be her! Right?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Whenever President Rudolf is involved, your vigor grows doubly tiresome…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Unlike you, I'm not here for fun. I've come purely for self-improvement.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: You're here to learn? You student council members sure are something else.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: …Wait, huh? Air Groove, aren't you entering the Arima Kinen yourself?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: If I could, I would.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: But it seems like my abilities have proved unworthy of this great stage.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Oh… Even you didn't qualify?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If even Air Groove, who Tokai Teio couldn't beat, couldn't qualify, then that means…
choice_data_list: Looks like you need some serious skill to enter this race.
Looks like you need some serious skill to enter this race.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: If you're planning on surpassing Rudolf, then you'd better watch carefully.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: See how she runs in a race even I'm no match for.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: See with your own eyes how high a wall you must overcome.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: How high a wall…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so the starting gates open for the big event at the end of the year: the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: This year's cream of the crop are turning for home! Who will come out on top?!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Someone's breaking away from the pack! It's Symboli Rudolf! Symboli Rudolf!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: And she finishes first! What a performance from Japan's finest Triple Crown champion!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: It's natural to be at a loss for words, Teio.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Even among the best of the best, she alone stands supreme.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: The road to achieving your dream will be more treacherous than you could ever imagine.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Treacherous…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the train back, Tokai Teio is completely silent.
choice_data_list: Symboli Rudolf really is one of a kind, huh?
Symboli Rudolf really is one of a kind, huh?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I mean, it's not like I didn't know that before, but…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: It wasn't until I debuted… until I started running on the same path she did, that I really got just how amazing she is.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Now it seems like the closer I think I'm getting to her, the further I really am.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hmmm… Mrghhh…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yup, that's enough! No matter how hard I think, it's not gonna change anything!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I've been thinking it over ever since the race ended…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I still want to surpass her! No matter how treacherous a journey it may be!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Of course, I'm still reeling from seeing how outclassed I am. But…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I've always looked up to her! Before I entered the academy up till now! And I always will!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: But no matter how strong Prez is, I won't give up! Ever!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm sure even Symboli Rudolf would be proud of Tokai Teio's resolve…
choice_data_list: Go make your dream come true!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yeah, leave it to me! I'm coming for you, Prez!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio reaffirms her dream to surpass Symboli Rudolf and heads toward the Classics!
